title.narrative: Green BRI and Export Opportunities for Climate Smart Agriculture in Lao PDR (Preparatory Grant)

description.narrative: In 2021, the China-financed Lao-China railway was completed and began operation, providing a high-speed rail connection from Vientiane into China (Kunming), a key achievement of China's Belt and Road Initiative, and an important step in transforming Lao PDR from a "land-locked" or a "land-linked" country. This rail line will be further extended to reach Bangkok by 2028, thereby connecting three contiguous markets of the Mekong region.The proposed project will take this infrastructure as its starting point, and scope, assess, ideate and form recommendations related to enhancing market opportunities for exporting climate-smart agriculture products from Lao PDR into China and Thailand. Linked to this, the project will be seeking a) policy and regulatory reform and development opportunities; b) investment mobilization opportunities; c) livelihood development opportunities, with a strong gender, indigenous peoples and youth dimension; and d) knowledge production opportunities. The project is initially conceived around 1) assessing both supply-side and demand-side drivers and policies for CSA in Lao PDR; 2) assessing CSA products and production systems which align with market demands; 3) identifying and formulating recommendations for policy products, market instruments and investment opportunities for subsequent engagement and support. In many ways, this project is a large scoping study - and it is intended to identify opportunities for subsequent work.This project will be formulated as a consortium with 1-2 research institutes, to compliment GGGI's policy and green growth expertise. As part of this, both capacity development and knowledge productions related to green BRI in the agriculture sector and CSA more generally in Lao PDR will be built.
